evals.name: login-card
evals.prompt: I exported one of our Figma screens as JSON (the API response is at assets/sample_login_card.json in the skill folder). It's a login card. Convert it into production-ready SwiftUI views I can drop into Xcode. I want real colors, fonts, layout, and a tokens file — not a screenshot guess.
evals.expected_output: A SwiftUI View (VStack-based login card) plus a DesignTokens file with the design's colors and fonts. Auto-layout maps to VStack/HStack with correct spacing/padding; button and text field flagged for follow-up.

evals.name: profile-header
evals.prompt: Here's a Figma profile-header row exported to JSON at assets/sample_profile_header.json. Build the SwiftUI for it. It has an avatar image, the user's name and handle stacked, and a settings icon on a horizontal row.
evals.expected_output: A SwiftUI View using HStack with an Image avatar, a nested VStack for name/handle, and an Image for the settings icon, plus a tokens file and an asset manifest listing the avatar and settings icon.
